purpose: Teach: 強姦/使徒/於い/草子/罎/謂/廣/來

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、性犯罪、つまり強姦罪の歴史的法制度の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your thesis dealt with the historical legal frameworks surrounding sexual assault crimes, didn't it?
lines.style: Measured, professional tone. Slight pause before the main clause—not accusing, genuinely checking understanding. Eyes steady over reading glasses. Warm undercurrent.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、十二使徒の文書研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my thesis focused on textual studies of the Twelve Apostles' documents.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. Small clarifying nod. Speaking carefully—he knows this is precise scholarship. No defensiveness, just accuracy.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下に於いて活動した学者の動向を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your work examined the activities and directions of scholars working during wartime, yes?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distanced tone—like she's reflecting on something larger than the moment. Genuine curiosity underneath. Not testing him, considering.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、枕草子、つまり古典草子の文体研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my thesis explored stylistic analysis of the Pillow Book and classical prose works.
lines.style: Patient redirection. He's used to this now. Speaks clearly without rushed energy. A small straightening of posture—stating his actual work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、古い玻璃の罎、つまり瓶の考古研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you researched ancient glass vessels—their archaeological significance, correct?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant. She's asking but also thinking. Deliberate pacing. Like she's testing whether he's listening to what he actually studied.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、所謂、つまり謂わゆる古文の用法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my paper addressed the grammatical usage of classical literary forms, specifically the term 'iwayuru.'
lines.style: Calm persistence. He's realized the pattern. Speaks with quiet conviction, no frustration—just steady correction. Small exhale.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、廣島、つまり旧字廣の地名表記の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your research covered the old character forms used in place names—Hiroshima written with traditional kanji, I believe?
lines.style: Reflective, measured. A knowing tone creeping in—almost gentle. She's giving him space to answer his own conversation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、古典の來、つまり来の用法の文法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my thesis examined the grammatical function of the classical verb 'kuru' and its historical usage patterns.
lines.style: Quiet but steady. He's still correcting gently, no edge. Slight weariness at the surface, underneath a kind of resigned grace. Finishing exhale.
